rules.text: Marriage is judged from three houses together: the 2nd (a new member joins the family), the 7th (the partner and the legal bond) and the 11th (lasting friendship and fulfilment). Looking at the 7th alone, as tradition does, is not enough.

The 12th house from a house works against it. Houses 1, 6 and 10 are the 12th from 2, 7 and 11, so they show obstacles, denial or separation in marriage; Krishnamurti judges separation from houses 1, 6, 10 and 12.
A planet gives mainly the results of its star lord: the matters of the houses its star lord rules come to the fore. The planet’s sub lord shows the net outcome, success or failure.
One period can bring both a wedding and a parting: the marriage comes through the star lord of the planet, the separation through its sub lord.
If a planet promises both a good and a bad result, it gives both in turn; one result does not cancel the other.
A natural indicator (Venus for marriage, Jupiter for children) counts mainly when it is also a significator of the houses being judged; being the indicator alone promises nothing.
Exalted planets or traditional yogas do not by themselves guarantee good results; Krishnamurti says everything depends on the sub.
Twins share almost the same planets; only the cusps move fast in a few minutes. So character and innate nature are read from the sub lord of the Ascendant, which can differ between twins.

In married life, significators of the 6th show the partner walking out; of the 12th, the native choosing to leave and live apart; of the 8th, quarrels and strain while the couple still stays together.
Children are judged from houses 2, 5 and 11. For the next child add the 7th, which is the 3rd from the 5th (the younger sibling of the first child).
Krishnamurti found no rule that predicts the sex of a child in every case; he says it needs long experience. Treat any such reading as tentative.
There is no astrological method to give the height of the partner; Krishnamurti says so plainly.

Tradition holds “karako bhava nasaya”: an indicator in its own house (Venus in the 7th, Jupiter in the 5th) harms it. Krishnamurti rejects this as a blanket rule: it harms only from the star of a planet evil by lordship; with a good star lord expect good.

Tradition times marriage by Jupiter’s transit counted from the Moon sign (Guru-bala). Krishnamurti rejects this as wholly unreliable; he times marriage by the periods of the 2-7-11 significators and by star-and-sub transits.

Tradition says a wife brings luck or misfortune to her husband. Krishnamurti rejects this: a promotion or a job loss after marriage is shown in the native’s own chart, and one period can signify both marriage and career.
Saturn in the 5th aspects the 7th, 11th and 2nd, all three marriage houses; Krishnamurti reads a long delay before marriage.

“Punarphoo”: Saturn and the Moon are linked by star and sub, with Saturn in house 1, 3, 6, 7 or 10. Expect obstacles in fixing the marriage (changed dates, extra cost, worry), though a better partner often follows. Commit only when the date is near.
Saturn is connected with the Moon and also signifies a marriage house: Krishnamurti expects difficulty and delay in fixing the marriage, though it does take place.
The 7th sub lord is tied to houses 4, 6 and 10: Krishnamurti’s pattern for proposals that keep failing; the 4th adds failure in love affairs. Read it together with the 2-7-11 promise.
The 7th sub lord is Jupiter or Venus and signifies the 2nd or 11th: Krishnamurti’s first sign of a happy married life.
Mars in the 8th in Jupiter’s sub: an extravagant partner; money troubles come first and domestic friction follows.
Mars in the Moon’s sub: Krishnamurti warns of a hasty, hot-tempered partner who is hard to restrain, more so when Mars or the Moon is in a water sign. Patience is needed.
The 7th sub lord is Mercury or sits in a dual sign (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces): Krishnamurti reads more than one marriage in life.
The sub lord of the 2nd cusp signifies the 7th: Krishnamurti reads a second marriage. The 7th describes the first spouse; the 2nd stands for the second.
Mars is in a traditional “dosha” house (1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12). Krishnamurti says Mars’s position alone is no curse: the planets in Mars’s stars or subs bring friction, and only in their own periods.
The 7th sub lord owns the 4th or 10th: the spouse comes from the same street, town or district, and no move is needed after marriage.
The 7th sub lord owns the 3rd: the spouse is a cousin or a neighbour, or lives a few hours away; the match may be settled by letter or advertisement.
The 7th sub lord owns the 11th: the spouse comes from a friend’s family.
The 7th sub lord owns the 5th or 9th: the spouse is a stranger, perhaps from far away or from another country; a love marriage is likely.
The 7th sub lord occupies the 4th: the spouse is from the native’s own town.
Saturn is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: a wide age gap between the partners (in a woman’s chart, a much older husband).
Jupiter, Venus or the Sun is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: a fitting, normal age difference between the partners.
Mars, Mercury or the Moon is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: very little age difference; a young partner.
The Sun is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: Krishnamurti reads little warmth between the couple; closeness needs effort.
The Moon is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: a very pleasant, tender bond between the couple.
Mars is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: quarrels and pressure in the couple’s private life; gentleness is needed.
Mercury is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: a lively, talkative and playful bond between the couple.
Jupiter is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: a normal, dutiful and steady bond between the couple.
Venus is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: strong mutual delight and affection between the couple.
Saturn is the star or sub lord of the 7th cusp: dissatisfaction in the couple’s private life; moments of closeness are brief.
The 7th sub lord is a node. To describe the spouse, read the planet conjoined with it; if none, the planet aspecting it; if none, the node’s star lord.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Aries): medium height, strong and well made, full eyes; bold and noble, stands up for own rights, proud, wins and does well socially.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Taurus): short and sturdy, broad face, athletic build; very self-assured, a good debater who argues well and wins.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Gemini): above average height, well proportioned, long nose, piercing eyes; courteous, tactful, accommodating and pleasant, though easily swayed by others.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Cancer): short and plain-looking; good-natured, harmless and cheerful, fond of music, dance and sport, but rather lazy about work.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Leo): strong build, big eyes, round broad face; faithful, reliable, punctual, fair-minded, ambitious and successful.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Virgo): tall and slender, very dark hair; fond of music and song, always smiling, never provoking, cheerful, spends much time on recreation.

Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Libra): tall and upright, big eyes, thin hair, good-looking; talks big but is not bold, weak in attachment and not always truthful. Krishnamurti advises against such a match.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Scorpio): square, fleshy build, broad face; inventive, very clever and brisk, ambitious, never accepts defeat or an equal; fortunate.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Sagittarius): tall, well proportioned, oval face; over-rates own ability, austere and strict, plans big things.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Capricorn): thin, wiry, long nose, frail look; pleasant manners though at times nasty, makes many friends and wins goodwill.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Aquarius): tall, well made, round face, good complexion; fair-natured and never deceitful, but proud and showy.
Spouse (7th sub lord Sun in Pisces): short, stout, round face, prominent eyes; partial and unfair, pleasure-loving and extravagant, which harms the person.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Aries): plump, round face, fair; stubborn, aggressive, argumentative and grasping, but ambitious and commanding.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Taurus): strong, just below average height, good-looking and fair; polite, modest, honest, helpful and pleasing.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Gemini): tall, upright, good complexion; inventive but unsteady and indecisive, not lucky in profession.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Cancer): average height, somewhat fleshy, round face; pleasant, harmless and peace-loving, easily influenced and changeable, sociable, fond of travel, fortunate.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Leo): well built, average height, big eyes; proud, ambitious and independent, will not serve under others; luck is uneven.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Virgo): tall, oval face; very clever but reserved and gloomy, inclined to low moods.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Libra): tall, attractive and witty, ever smiling, fond of amusement and of admiration from the other sex; fortune is uneven.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Scorpio): below average height, stout; very impulsive and irregular; Krishnamurti calls this a less desirable partner.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Sagittarius): good-looking, well built, oval face; honest, true, generous, quick and passionate; lucky.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Capricorn): thin and slight; dull, inactive, pessimistic and self-centred, often ignored even by friends.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Aquarius): medium height, well made; very intelligent and studious, fit for research, most courteous, never offensive, upright.
Spouse (7th sub lord Moon in Pisces): below average height, plump, full face; inactive except for pleasure, unsteady and inconstant; luck is poor.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Aries): medium height, big bones, curly hair, dark; very bold, rash, over-confident, proud and quarrelsome, yet always gains.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Taurus): medium height, strong, coarse hair, broad face; self-indulgent, arrogant and speculative; luck is poor.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Gemini): very tall, well proportioned and always active; restless, mischievous, clever and cunning, moves house often and is slow to repay debts.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Cancer): short, dusky, sparse hair, uneven build; may find steady, responsible work hard to keep.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Leo): tall, well built, dark, sturdy limbs, brisk; fond of shooting, riding and sport, quarrelsome, drawn to police or military life, dresses well.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Virgo): medium height, thick nose, dark; hasty, impulsive, proud, passionate and vindictive, slow to forgive.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Libra): tall, attractive, oval face, ruddy; active, cheerful and hopeful, but boastful, vain and haughty, well dressed, fond of the other sex.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Scorpio): stout, dark, curly hair, broad face; rash, unsociable, revengeful and fond of disputes, proud, yet very intelligent.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Sagittarius): tall, well proportioned, ruddy, piercing eyes; hopeful, jovial, cheerful, quick, bold and talkative.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Capricorn): short, lean, dark; witty, humorous, intelligent, lucky, pushing and successful.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Aquarius): well built, fair and buoyant; a good debater who loves to argue; average fortune.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mars in Pisces): below average height, dark, untidy look; dull, idle, careless and self-indulgent; luck is poor.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Aries): medium height, thin, oval face, brownish hair; quick in thought and speech, expressive, inventive, studious, a writer, but impulsive and unmethodical.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Taurus): stout, strong, dark, short thick hair; cheerful, a little lazy, artistic and diplomatic, determined, fond of company and of saving money.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Gemini): tall, well built, brown hair; intelligent, eloquent, clever and versatile (a lawyer or agent type), resourceful, generous, good-humoured, speculative.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Cancer): short, stout, small eyes, sharp nose; changeable and unsteady, a little lazy, yet tactful, faithful, sociable and fond of parties.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Leo): good stature, round face, broad eyes; quick-tempered but kind-hearted, ambitious, intuitive, a good organiser, fond of music, drama and arts.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Virgo): tall, lean, brown hair; very intelligent, cautious, practical and prudent, a scholar and good writer, an alert worker, interested in the occult.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Libra): tall, thin, brown hair; broad-minded and dispassionate, weighs and compares everything, a good judge, artistic, good at mathematics, social.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Scorpio): short, broad shoulders, dark; stubborn, reckless, critical and suspicious, pleasure-seeking, often troubled by friends and relatives.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Sagittarius): tall, big-boned, oval face, long nose; sincere, just and independent but rebellious; mentally active, prophetic, fond of nature, authoritative.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Capricorn): thin, dark, thin brown hair; irritable, discontented and suspicious, yet painstaking, studious and persevering, drawn to science and the occult.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Aquarius): medium build, attractive, fair; original, penetrating and humanitarian, a keen reader and researcher, fond of occult study and theory.
Spouse (7th sub lord Mercury in Pisces): short, stout, pale; intuitive, quick to understand, versatile, with a good memory and an analytical mind; finds pleasure in nursing others.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Aries): medium build, expressive eyes, high nose; progressive, generous, philosophical, noble, polite and studious, fond of travel and sport; fortunate.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Taurus): medium height, stout; affectionate, reserved, steady and religious; gains through the other sex, gifts and investments; marries early; a dutiful partner.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Gemini): well built, penetrating eyes; sympathetic, kind, friendly and trustworthy, broad-minded but restless; some difficulty around the wedding.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Cancer): short, stout, pale; charitable, enterprising, sympathetic and popular, intuitive and artistic, patriotic, loves home yet travels.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Leo): tall, strong, curly dark hair, big eyes, good-looking; noble, prudent, loyal, generous and diplomatic, values prestige and permanence.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Virgo): tall, well built, fair, good-looking; intelligent, cautious, analytical, wise and honest, chooses friends with care, popular.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Libra): tall, handsome, oval face; earnest, obliging, peaceful and charitable, artistic, fond of travel; a happy marriage with good children.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Scorpio): well built, attractive; strong-willed, deeply emotional, ambitious and self-confident, analytical and research-minded.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Sagittarius): tall, upright, stout, may go bald; courteous, generous, tolerant, loyal and humane; successful, with gains.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Capricorn): thin, below average height; capable, creative, ambitious and thrifty, successful in public life, travels far; orthodox views.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Aquarius): below average height, deep-set eyes; good-humoured, sympathetic, dislikes quarrels, spiritual, drawn to astrology, independent in views.
Spouse (7th sub lord Jupiter in Pisces): below average height, plump; strong-willed yet emotional, imaginative and intuitive, simple and unassuming, loves nature and good company.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Aries): average height, thin, attractive, perhaps a mark on the face; artistic, musical, affectionate, loving and popular.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Taurus): attractive, well proportioned, a little stout; emotional, affectionate, faithful, careful and determined, saves money and enjoys life.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Gemini): medium height, fair, dark hair; good-humoured, many interests and occupations, a writer, speaker or musician; more than one love affair, unsteady.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Cancer): short, stout, round face; home-loving, kind and imaginative, close to mother and family; several attachments, and the marriage is not very fortunate.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Leo): tall, well built, clear eyes, fair; sympathetic, kind, charitable and sincere, attractive, gifted in music or acting, gains by speculation.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Virgo): tall, well built, oval face; intelligent and sympathetic, but not fully content in love; gains through medicine, gardening and speculation.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Libra): tall, upright, very attractive, long hair, ever smiling; kind, affectionate and artistic, a pleasant and inseparable companion.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Scorpio): short, stout, robust, dark; lavish, impulsive, passionate and emotional; gains through gifts, partnership or dowry, but has troubles in love.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Sagittarius): tall, fair, long face; refined, light-hearted, imaginative and intuitive, loves travel, nature and outdoor games; gains from many sources.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Capricorn): thin, pale look; trustworthy, responsible and business-like, good at banking and investment, ambitious; marriage comes late.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Aquarius): attractive, well built, fair; sympathetic, humane, social and romantic, gains through friends; most hopes are fulfilled.
Spouse (7th sub lord Venus in Pisces): medium height, stout, very fair; charitable, compassionate, emotional and inspired, fond of painting, music and society.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Aries): dark, thin, bony; boastful but determined and very ambitious, with a good analytical mind; meets obstacles.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Taurus): plain looks, stout; steady but quick to anger and resentful, hard to satisfy, very thrifty; home life is not very fortunate.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Gemini): tall, dark; intelligent, able to concentrate, fond of science, statistics and literature; trouble through cousins, disputes and false complaints.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Cancer): thin, not tall, frail look, deep-set eyes; restless, discontented and changeable, moves house often, but very industrious.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Leo): tall, broad face, big shoulders, sunken eyes; generous, stubborn and God-fearing, hard-working; not happy in love.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Virgo): tall, thin, long forehead; cautious, thrifty and reserved, much given to worry; home life lacks harmony.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Libra): tall, long face, broad forehead; commands respect, scientific mind, but disappointment in love, a delayed marriage and a risk of separation.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Scorpio): medium height, stout, big shoulders; forceful, passionate and jealous, prone to drink and bad habits; unhappy in domestic life.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Sagittarius): large build; helpful, fearless, humane and philosophical, detached by nature; meets many obstacles, may have more than one occupation.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Capricorn): lean, bony, stooping; serious, cautious and reserved but peevish and not reliable; an unhappy, dissatisfied marriage.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Aquarius): tall, big head, deep-set eyes; thoughtful, reserved, intellectual and sociable; a faithful, romantic married life.
Spouse (7th sub lord Saturn in Pisces): medium height, prominent eyes, uneven teeth; open to deception and blackmail, many disappointments and worries in love, tires easily.
Aries rises in the sub of the Moon or Venus: a modest, gentle nature, unlike the usual picture of Aries.
Aries rises in Mars’s own sub: a militant, forceful temperament.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 1st: the native guards personal dignity, puts down hostility, and enjoys a fortunate life with harmony and happiness.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 2nd: the native works long hours, is always after money, and gains through industrious work.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 3rd: strong mental growth, gains from frequent short journeys, good ties with relatives and neighbours; keeps adding agencies, though success may be slow.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 4th: interest in land, buildings, vehicles, mines, possessions and study; good relations with the mother.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 5th: delight in sports, music, the stage and speculation; anxious to bring up the children well.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 6th: the native can win contests and attempts, but tends to cause loss to those dealt with, and disharmony follows.

The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 7th: good partners in life and business, understanding with the spouse, fond of the company of the other sex; some litigation in life; happiness in marriage.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 8th: occult experiences; gains through a legacy but only after great trouble; nothing comes smoothly, with many obstacles.

The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 9th: love of long journeys, religious mind, higher studies, success in research, prophetic dreams; gains through, and good ties with, the in-laws and the father.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 10th: name and fame, success in undertakings, favour of superiors, a high social and professional position, and easy inheritance.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 11th: success all round, many friends, a smooth life, social and financial gains.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 12th: secret unhappiness and hidden opponents, fear of confinement, and misfortune to face.
The sub lord of the Ascendant signifies the 12th together with 2, 6 and 11: the native makes a fortune in a foreign place.
The sub lord of the Ascendant is Mars and signifies the 6th: Krishnamurti warns of bold, open wrongdoing against others; firm guidance and discipline matter.
The sub lord of the Ascendant is Saturn and signifies the 6th: Krishnamurti warns of wrongdoing done quietly, out of others’ sight; firm guidance and discipline matter.
For an Aries or Scorpio Lagna, Mars rules the Ascendant but also the 8th or the 6th: many troubles are self-invited through haste and quarrels; restraint helps.
For a Cancer, Leo, Sagittarius or Pisces Lagna, Mars is a helpful, yoga-giving planet.
For a Gemini or Virgo Lagna, Mars is an evil planet (more so for Virgo): it brings arrogance, haste and disputes.
For a Taurus or Libra Lagna, Mars is inauspicious (more so for Taurus).
For a Capricorn or Aquarius Lagna, Mars is mostly helpful in material affairs.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Sun and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, ruby and the colours orange or deep red suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Moon and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, pearl and the colours white and silvery suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Mars and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, coral and the colours deep red suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Mercury and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, emerald and the colours green or slate suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Jupiter and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, topaz and the colours purple, violet, blue or white suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Venus and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, diamond and the colours yellow or pale blue suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Saturn and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, sapphire and the colours brown, indigo or black suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Rahu and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, agate or turquoise and the colours mixed colours suit the native.
The sub lord of the Ascendant or of the 11th cusp is Ketu and is free of 6, 8 and 12: by Krishnamurti’s gem rule, agate or turquoise and the colours mixed colours suit the native.
The 5th or 11th cusp falls in a barren sign (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Virgo): one of Krishnamurti’s signs that children come with some difficulty; the cusp sub lords decide.
Love nature (5th sub lord in Aries). As a man: frank, eager and possessive, quick-tempered, apt to marry in haste. As a woman: independent and passionate, likes to lead; should curb pride and temper.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Taurus). As a man: slow to choose a partner, then loyal; sensuous; wants a respected, settled home. As a woman: love is tied to security, wealth weighs in the choice; a thrifty home-maker.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Gemini). As a man: makes and drops friends quickly, delays commitment, wants variety and a clever companion. As a woman: wants mental companionship and outside work; torn between career and home.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Cancer). As a man: romantic, loyal and home-loving, but poor at showing love; avoids divorce. As a woman: sincere and devoted but moody, wants attention; may remarry for security.
Love nature (5th sub lord in Leo). As a man: ardent, proud and generous; needs an appreciative wife. As a woman: idealistic, runs the home admirably, active in social work; loyal, spends freely.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Virgo). As a man: an idealist, slow to marry, values intellect over romance. As a woman: understands her husband, dutiful and thrifty, sees marriage as a partnership; reserved in intimacy.
Love nature (5th sub lord in Libra). As a man: a charming, ardent lover whose passion may cool; adjusts and avoids divorce. As a woman: marries early, tactful, likes comfort, luxury and praise.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Scorpio). As a man: intense and faithful; kind or harsh depending on how the partner responds. As a woman: deeply loyal when loved, fierce in temper, no patience with weak men.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Sagittarius). As a man: sporting, honest and frank, even about other attractions; quick temper, quick regret. As a woman: independent, outdoor and career-minded; wants freedom.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Capricorn). As a man: reserved, slow and dutiful, hides affection; prefers a younger wife and needs a contented home. As a woman: a devoted home-keeper who plans the family and hides her feelings.

Love nature (5th sub lord in Aquarius). As a man: wants an educated, intelligent partner; undemonstrative; loves children. As a woman: one of two extremes; would rather endure a poor match than divorce.
Love nature (5th sub lord in Pisces). As a man: emotional and sentimental, kind, but can be suspicious and jealous. As a woman: varied, either simple and philosophical or restless when unfulfilled.
The 11th sub lord signifies 1 and 5: a son-in-law (the 11th is the 7th from the 5th) brings peace to the family.
The 11th sub lord signifies 6 or 12: a son-in-law (the 11th is the 7th from the 5th) may not bring peace; relations need care.
